exposure: exclusive breastfeeding until the third month of age
outcome: gut microbiota composition (Firmicutes abundance and diversity)
cohort: The study included 1,592 infants from the Canadian Healthy Infants Longitudinal Development Cohort, with data on environmental exposure and lifestyle factors collected prenatally and throughout the first three years.
finding: Maternal smoking during pregnancy significantly increased Firmicutes abundance and diversity, mediating an elevated risk of childhood overweight and obesity, possibly through excessive microbial butyrate production.
